# #2Code Studio

> #2Code Studio is an independent digital, creative and technology studio based in Shivamogga, Karnataka, India. The studio brings design, technology and creative thinking together to build websites, digital experiences, brands, applications and custom software that help businesses move forward.

## Official Information

- Official name: #2Code Studio
- Business type: Digital, Creative and Technology Studio

- Phone: +91 9036486726

- Languages: English
- Business model: Client services, custom development and creative collaborations

## About #2Code Studio

#2Code Studio is an independent studio focused on helping businesses establish, improve and grow their digital presence.

The studio combines website development, software engineering, visual design and creative services to deliver practical solutions for real business needs.

Rather than treating design and technology as separate activities, #2Code brings them together throughout the project lifecycle — from understanding the business challenge and planning the solution to designing, developing and delivering the final product.

The studio works with businesses, entrepreneurs, organisations and teams looking for reliable digital and creative solutions.

Its approach is built around:
- Thoughtful design and purposeful execution.
- Technology that solves practical problems.
- Modern, responsive and user-friendly digital experiences.
- Clear communication and collaborative development.
- Solutions designed around each client's requirements.
- Continued support and a smooth project handover.

## Core Services

### 1. Website Development

Design and development of professional websites and digital experiences for businesses and organisations.

Services include:
- Business and corporate websites.
- Professional company websites.
- Landing pages and conversion-focused websites.
- Portfolio and personal websites.
- Dental clinic and healthcare websites.
- Restaurant and hospitality websites.
- Educational and institutional websites.
- E-commerce and product websites.
- Custom web applications.
- Website redesign and modernisation.
- Responsive and mobile-first development.
- Website maintenance and improvements.

### 2. Social Media Marketing and Management

Creative and strategic social media services designed to help businesses establish a consistent online presence.

Services include:
- Social media content planning.
- Social media account management.
- Creative content development.
- Brand communication and visual consistency.
- Social media campaign support.
- Digital content strategy.

### 3. Video Editing

Professional video editing and visual storytelling for brands, businesses and digital platforms.

Services include:
- Instagram Reels editing.
- Short-form promotional videos.
- Brand videos.
- Marketing and advertising videos.
- Product and service videos.
- Social media video content.
- Creative storytelling and post-production.

### 4. Graphic Designing

Visual communication and creative design that helps businesses present a consistent and recognisable brand.

Services include:
- Brand identity design.
- Logo and branding assets.
- Social media creatives.
- Promotional posters and banners.
- Marketing materials.
- Digital advertisements.
- Business presentations.
- Visual communication assets.

### 5. Mobile App Development

Development of useful, intuitive mobile applications based on business requirements and user needs.

Services include:
- Custom mobile applications.
- Business applications.
- Customer-facing applications.
- Application UI and UX design.
- Backend and database integration.
- Application functionality and API integration.

### 6. Custom Software and Automation

Purpose-built software systems and automated workflows that help businesses reduce repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.

Services include:
- Custom business software.
- Internal management systems.
- Admin dashboards.
- Workflow automation.
- Database-driven applications.
- API integrations.
- Business process digitisation.
- Custom operational tools.

### 7. Digital Product Engineering

End-to-end digital product development, from early-stage ideas to functional digital solutions.

Services include:
- Product discovery and planning.
- Technical architecture.
- UI and UX design.
- Frontend development.
- Backend development.
- Database design and integration.
- MVP development.
- Product iteration and improvements.
- Deployment and handover.

## Technology and Development Capabilities

#2Code Studio works with modern web technologies and development tools, selected according to project requirements.

Technologies and capabilities include:

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- UI development: Tailwind CSS and component-based interfaces.
- Backend and data: Supabase, databases and API integrations.
- Application development: Custom web applications and software systems.
- Animation: Framer Motion and interactive web experiences.
- Deployment: Vercel and Netlify.
- Version control: Git and GitHub.
- Integrations: Payment gateways, third-party APIs, analytics and automation tools.

Technology selection depends on the scope, requirements and long-term needs of each project.

## Project Approach

The studio follows a four-stage working process:

### 1. Understand
Understand the client's business, audience, objectives, requirements and challenges.

### 2. Imagine
Explore possible solutions, define the direction, map the experience and establish a clear project scope.

### 3. Create
Bring design and development together through focused execution, collaboration and iteration.

### 4. Launch and Grow
Deliver the solution, support the handover and help the client continue improving their digital presence.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does #2Code Studio do?
#2Code Studio provides website development, social media marketing and management, video editing, graphic design, mobile app development, custom software, automation and digital product engineering.

### Where is #2Code Studio located?
#2Code Studio is based in Shivamogga, Karnataka, India.

### Does #2Code Studio work with businesses outside Shivamogga?
Yes. The studio works with businesses across Karnataka, Kerala and other locations through remote collaboration.

### Can #2Code Studio build a website for a small business?
Yes. The studio develops professional websites and digital experiences for small businesses, startups, service providers and established organisations.

### Can #2Code Studio develop custom software?
Yes. The studio develops custom software, business systems, dashboards, database-driven applications and automated workflows based on business requirements.

### Can #2Code Studio help with an early-stage startup idea?
Yes. The studio can help define the idea, identify the right technical direction and develop an initial digital product or minimum viable product.

### Does #2Code Studio offer mobile app development?
Yes. Mobile application development is one of the studio's services.

### How can someone start a project with #2Code Studio?
Interested clients can contact the studio through its official email, phone number, website or Instagram account to discuss their requirements.
